description: Java entity class representing a share account in the Fineract microfinance platform, including fields, constructors, and methods for managing share account state and transactions.

classes.name: ShareAccount
classes.description: Entity class for managing share account data, including state transitions, transactions, charges, and related entities.

methods.name: ShareAccount
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new ShareAccount with provided details.

methods.name: setShareProduct
methods.description: Sets the share product if different from current.

methods.name: setSubmittedDate
methods.description: Updates the submitted date if different.

methods.name: setApprovedDate
methods.description: Updates the approved date if different.

methods.name: setExternalId
methods.description: Sets the external ID if different.

methods.name: setSavingsAccount
methods.description: Associates a savings account if different.

methods.name: setPurchasedShares
methods.description: Replaces the set of share account transactions.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a share account transaction and updates total shares pending/approved.

methods.name: setAllowDividendCalculationForInactiveClients
methods.description: Sets dividend calculation allowance for inactive clients.

methods.name: setLockPeriodFrequencyEnum
methods.description: Sets the lock-in period frequency type.

methods.name: setminimumActivePeriodTypeEnum
methods.description: Sets the minimum active period type.

methods.name: setCharges
methods.description: Sets the charges for the share account.

methods.name: updateAccountNumber
methods.description: Updates the account number and disables auto-generation.

methods.name: isAccountNumberRequiresAutoGeneration
methods.description: Checks if account number requires auto-generation.

methods.name: getSavingsAccountNo
methods.description: Returns the associated savings account number.

methods.name: addAdditionalPurchasedShares
methods.description: Adds a purchased share transaction, updating total shares pending/approved.

methods.name: addShareAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to the share account.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves the share account and its transactions.

methods.name: undoApprove
methods.description: Reverts approval status and resets related fields.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the share account and its transactions.

methods.name: retrievePurchasedShares
methods.description: Retrieves a specific share transaction by ID.

methods.name: removePendingShares
methods.description: Removes a specified number of pending shares.

methods.name: getOfficeId
methods.description: Returns the office ID associated with the client.

methods.name: getShareAccountTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transaction matching given details.

methods.name: removeTransactions
methods.description: Deactivates all transactions and resets approved/pending shares.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns current status of the share account.
